create_optimizer_radam: create a RAdam optimizer instance for PyTorch model parameters with configurable learning rate and weight decay
create_optimizer_plainradam: create a PlainRAdam optimizer instance for PyTorch model parameters without internal step buffering
run_optimizer_step: run the optimizer step method to update model parameters using adaptive learning rate based on RAdam algorithm
test_optimizer_weight_decay: test the optimizer with weight decay enabled to apply L2 regularization during parameter updates
review_optimizer_sparse_gradients: review the optimizer behavior when sparse gradients are encountered and raise RuntimeError
